evals.name: matrix-from-exports
evals.prompt: 我们刚从模板做了一个新产品 Clipo，产品说明在 docs/product/product.md。eval-input/ahrefs-export.csv 是 Ahrefs 的关键词导出，eval-input/serp-export.csv 是这些词的 SERP overview 导出。帮我把关键词矩阵做出来，然后告诉我第一批应该做哪些页面。
evals.expected_output: seo/keywords.csv has all 18 keywords; seo/matrix.json clusters them by shared results and intent, rejects the out-of-scope ones and keeps the competitor ones as candidates; nothing is planned yet. The reply ranks the clusters, recommends a first batch and asks the maintainer to choose.
expectations: The run used scripts/import.mjs and scripts/cluster.mjs instead of writing its own CSV parsing or clustering code
The reply lists the clusters by opportunity score and recommends a first batch from clusters with business, intent and productFit all 4 or more
The reply asks the maintainer to choose the first batch instead of choosing it
Every cluster with business, intent and productFit all 4 or more is either recommended or given a reason for leaving it out
The reply says the competitor keywords (creatify alternative) need a new page type such as /compare and asks before adding it

evals.name: briefs-for-first-batch
evals.prompt: 第一批就做 how-to-make-product-videos 和 etsy-listing-video 这两个 Cluster，帮我写 brief。
evals.expected_output: seo/briefs/how-to-make-product-videos.md and seo/briefs/etsy-listing-video.md follow the template; both clusters are planned; product facts cite docs/product/product.md; Etsy rules are cited from Etsy's own help with a date or marked as to be confirmed.
expectations: Every product fact under Facts to use names its source (docs/product/product.md or another file)
Etsy's video rules (length, size, format) are either cited from Etsy's official help with a check date or marked as to be confirmed; none is stated without a source
Not in this page sends the other clusters' topics to their URLs (for example / or /blog/shopify-product-video) instead of covering them
No product capability that product.md does not list (editing, avatars, voice-over) appears in the outline
No fact marked as unverified under Facts to use is stated as fact in the Outline

evals.name: search-console-review
evals.prompt: 网站上线两个月了。eval-input/search-analytics.csv 是 Search Console API 导出的查询 × 页面数据（dimensions: query, page）。帮我看看有什么问题，下一步先改什么。
evals.expected_output: The reply finds the cannibalization of 'how do ai credits work' between /blog/how-credits-work and /pricing, lists the striking-distance queries, proposes adding the new queries and asks before any page merge or canonical change. Importing is optional; imported queries have source gsc.
expectations: The reply names 'how do ai credits work' as cannibalization between /blog/how-credits-work and /pricing and keeps /blog/how-credits-work (cluster how-credits-work) as its page
The reply lists 'ai credits explained', 'do ai credits expire' and 'pay per use ai tool' as striking distance (average position 8–20)

For the cannibalization, the reply proposes a concrete change to /pricing (trim or rewrite the part that answers 'how do ai credits work' and link to /blog/how-credits-work) and asks before editing page copy; it does not propose merging pages or a canonical change
The reply proposes adding the new queries ('do ai credits expire', 'ai credits refund') to seo/keywords.csv or to a cluster
